cases.name: Kimberly Moore
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Kimberly had worked as a secretary for Aronov Realty in Montgomery, Alabama, before taking time off to raise her family. She took pride in being a mother to her children and was a devout woman of faith. In her free time, Kimberly enjoyed reading and spending time with her children."
cases.narrative: He allegedly used a towel to strangle her to death at the nursing home where they lived. A statement from Heritage of Waterville said facility staff found her dead.
